resources.string: Short daily sessions with spaced repetition. You set the goal, and the app stops when you reach it.
The word deck couldn’t be loaded. Restart the app to try again.
Add a word from the dictionary
Look up a word you met in your reading and add the meaning you need to your collection.
Only the word you type is sent to dictionaryapi.dev. Your progress and history stay on this device.
No definition was found. Check the spelling or try a different form of the word.
Type a single English word or short phrase, using letters only.
You seem to be offline. Your saved words still work; try the lookup again when you are connected.
The dictionary is not responding right now. Please try again later.
Added to your collection. It will appear in your next session.
This word is already in your collection.
The pronunciation could not be played. Check that a text-to-speech voice is installed in your device settings.
The dictionary’s recording isn’t available, so your device’s voice read the word.
